notes.title: Update notes for July 2025
notes.content:
We have fixed some issues in sounds management (some sounds where not muted when setting the audio volume for SFX to 0).
We also improved some animations in the inventory when items are added or removed.

notes.title: Update notes for June 2025.
notes.content: We made a few minor improvements and... yes, we removed the solutions! But the clues are still here of course ;)

notes.title: Update May 15th 2025
notes.content: We have enhanced the inventory system for a smoother use: all the items are now displayed without requiring a click on the bag.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
We have enhanced the player experience by simplifying the navigation to the modules that have already been visited.
The Escape et Space keys may now be used to close the main text bubble.
